method_limitations: Only delivered queues and persisted mentions are available; cap-dropped titles are not fully recorded.
Source timestamps are collection times, not publication/release dates.
Current feedback is last retained opinion, not complete revision history.
Release dates must be checked independently before calling an item a new release.
Spotify release_date describes the returned edition, not necessarily the original recording.
Source attribution uses earliest collection per canonical identity/source, not article publication dates.
Source counts overlap and describe delivered observations, not all publisher output or causal source effects.
The short three-track Deafheaven EP is reported separately from albums.
New curator coverage is partial; absence of feedback is not a negative outcome.
